scene_description: Light gray wood-grain desk along a wall with a power-outlet strip at its back edge. A charger block is plugged into the outlet strip at the back edge, and a whiteboard eraser lies on the open desk top. Front is the edge away from the wall.

targets.name: charger block
targets.description: Small black charger block plugged into an outlet on the strip along the back edge of the desk.
targets.orientation: upright, plugged into the outlet strip
nearby_obstacles: Outlet strip it is plugged into
targets.clearance_notes: Front and sides are open, but it is held in the outlet at the very back of the desk.

candidate_improvements.description: Unplug the charger and set it on the desk approximately 15 cm in front of the strip.

targets.other_notes: Plugged in; must be unplugged before it is moved.

targets.name: whiteboard eraser
targets.description: Gray felt whiteboard eraser lying flat on the open desk top, left of center.

source: Staged permutation of S0035 and S0039, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
